You are apologized to a family whose son was engaged in criminal activity and who did not follow the directions of law enforcement officers. He would be alive today, had he made that choice. Where is your apology to his victims? He caused them trauma. Put yourself in their shoes and think how it would feel to have a gun held to your head. Would you feel that apologizing to the perpetrator of that crime is appropriate? I work with trauma victims and I am here to tell you that you let them down. You minimized their pain. You minimize the value of our law enforcement. Are you willing to give up your security provided by them? If not you need to be backing them and supporting them with your whole heart. I can't imagine how it feels to protect someone who doesn't support you. My hat is off to the officers who do that for you. What did you do to protect your city, your citizens and your police department? All reports point to your tying the hands of the police department and facilitating a liberal agenda, which would include inciting unrest, similar to the actions of other Democrat politicians around the nation, in an effort to affect November elections in a rather counterfeit fashion. On the night of July 18th, protesters were allowed to gather in front of the governor's mansion where they illegally used their own cars to block traffic. City streets and access to businesses were shut down, allowing protesters to march from the governor's mansion to the State Capitol. Last week, you allowed protesters to unlawfully assemble, block traffic and cause hundreds of thousands of dollars of damage to the new D.A.?s office. Hear this loud and clear: Utah residents were and are disgusted with your lack of courage and leadership and for your inaction in allowing these things to happen and we will not stand for it! Salt Lake City is not Seattle. It is not Los Angeles. We are better than that, and need to behave better than what we have seen from other cities, where the leadership is determined to destroy whom and what they have stewardship over, in an effort to push a political agenda. You have been granted a sacred duty to serve and protect the citizens, not a political party, an agenda, or a personal vision. Your actions are putting children and others at risk. You are focusing on the distraction and are not paying attention to what is a disgrace to humanity and is occurring right under our noses. Please further educate yourself. Some of the decisions you have made and pushed have caused a rise in child abuse and domestic violence. The mask mandate allows human trafficking to go on unnoticed as the masks (like in the Elizabeth Smart case) cover up their way of asking for help. Please read this. https://thefederalist.com/2020/07/17/lockdowns-protests-causing-big-spike-in-child-trafficking/ Please believe that THIS is happening and the other agendas in the media are covering this up. This is not the fault of the officers. Take the color out of it to see the clear picture. Take the color out of it to stop racism. Please look at all sides and not just one. Hello, Chris, We need you to do better. I'm writing this with the assumption that you are not beholden to nefarious interests that desire chaos & the destruction of our community. I still have hope we have good people in our elected offices. As a resident of a nearby city, my husband and family & I used to spend frequent evenings out in SLC, enjoying the diverse restaurants, supporting the local arts, developing our children's appreciation of our culture & doing nearly all of our family shopping in your city. Since your absolute abdication of your role in securing peace in your community, we have avoided going into your city and have spent zero dollars instead of the normally more than $1000 we would spend in an average month. Failing absolutely in keeping your city safe for ALL community members, not just protesters, has consequences. I am disgusted by your so-called leadership and especially your handling of recent conflicts between police & protesters. Enough is enough. DO YOUR JOB. My children, husband & I deserve to be able to peacefully visit the Capitol, the downtown, and historical sit's without worrying about whether streets will be blocked, whether protesters will be allowed to harass us in our cars, or whether we will be able to protect our family should a mob form that seeks to cause disruption to the lawful members of the community. ?Protesters' were allowed to gather in front of the governor's mansion, they illegally used their own cars to block traffic. WHY DID CITY LEADERSHIP ALLOW THIS? These people are an unruly mob, laying on property that isn't theirs, disrupting travel when they have no right to do so. It's appalling. City streets and access to businesses were shut down, allowing protesters to march from the governor's mansion to the State Capitol. Last week, in a predictable debacle, protesters unlawfully assembled, blocked traffic and caused hundreds of thousands of dollars of damage to the new county D.A.?s office. This should not have been allowed to happen. When the red paint showed up, the entire event should have been shut down. Hear this: Utah residents are disgusted with your lack of courage and leadership and for your inaction in allowing these things to happen. We can no longer sit silently by and allow our cities to set upon by a mob based on an entirely counterfactual narrative. Salt Lake City is not Seattle. It is not Los Angeles. We need better leadership than those two cities and this could be your time to shine. You have been given stewardship over the structure of our very lives. Your failure to stand up and defend good people and instead allow lies to be broadcast in an effort to push a political agenda is nearly seditious. You have been granted a sacred duty to serve and protect the citizens, not a political party, an agenda, or a personal vision. How will you be remembered? You can be remembered and revered as an effective leader of a great community, or you can be remembered as a disgrace. So far, your council is a disaster. Politics are insignificant compared to the personal and financial security of our lawful residents. Please show the good people of our community that your priorities are in the right place. Truly responsible leadership, that which is driven by a love for the people and not loyalty to a ?cause,? is always rewarded at re-election time. If you wish to continue to serve, please help our community by doing the right thing & protecting the peaceful among us. Frustrated by your poor leadership, Amanda Woodruff
